advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Guard the isolated-mode `rebar init --silent` with an rc check that emits a clear FATAL message on failure.
evidence: Contrast with the explicit FATAL guards at lines 35-38 that check dependency availability before proceeding.
This is the load-bearing precondition for CLASS 1's fix — the entire non-interactive run depends on it succeeding.
advisory.finding: The new `rebar init --silent` in isolated setup (line 88) runs in a subshell without asserting success; if init fails the script proceeds and ~100 downstream asserts fail with no direct signal to the init being the root cause.
scenarios: A future rebar change alters init's flags/behavior and `init --silent` starts failing; the probe reports a cascade of unrelated failures instead of a clear init error.
advisory.suggested_fix: ( cd "$REBAR_ROOT" && "$RB" init --silent ) || { echo "FATAL: rebar init failed in isolated setup"; exit 1; }

coaching.coaching: Add a regression test covering the unchecked rebar init in isolated setup.
coaching.subject: the unchecked rebar init in isolated setup
